lines.en: Chapter Nine: Inauspicious degrees and effects in the fījah. The benefit of this chapter is that one looks at the ascendant;

lines.text: کدام درجه است اگر مولود بدرجه سعد باشد دلالت کند بر سلامت و دولت و
lines.en: which degree it is. If the native is in an auspicious degree, it indicates health and wealth, and

lines.text: اگر بدرجه بد زاید دلالت کند بر نحوست و شقاوت
lines.en: if born in a bad degree, it indicates inauspiciousness and misery.

summary.headline: Inauspicious Degrees by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Chapter Nine explains how auspicious, intermediate, and inauspicious degrees of the ascendant affect health, wealth, misery, and fortune. A table lists these degrees for all twelve zodiac signs, including degrees of az-Zafah and intermediate effects.
